text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute and two of her friends
have been
selected for an interview. It
seems to be for a
special issue on dirt
racers.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what's taking Tarumae so long.
I thought
she was just changing...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Do you think we should go check on
her? I'm
getting kinda worried.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
S-sorry! It took me longer than I
expected.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I've been so nervous ever since last
night. I
realized I forgot to brush my tail.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Sniffle... I tried to brush it out real quick, but... it looks terrible, doesn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh my. There, there, dearie. Just take a
nice,
deep breath.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I've got just the thing for tail-related
worries. It
should be in my bag here
somewhere...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Here we are. A bit of this and your tail
will be nice
and lustrous in no time.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It's a cream made with beeswax and tea
seed oil. I
actually planned on giving
you both some today
anyway, so this is
perfect timing.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I tell you, this is the key to smooth and
shiny hair.
Go ahead and try it out—nice
and easy, now.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Th-thank you!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Oh noooo!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
A thread's come loose on the sleeve of
my
signature racewear! What am I gonna
do?!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It must've happened the other day when
I cut
through those bushes to avoid
running in an
unlucky direction...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, come over here. I'll take care
of this in
two shakes of a lamb's tail.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
This stitch isn't very strong, but it should
hold for
the interview. I'll fix it up proper
once we're
finished.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Oooh, thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Huh? What the?!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oh my, what a day we're having.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry! I didn't mean to shout. It's just
that my
pen's not working and I didn't
bring a spare...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
This is so embarrassing. I should've been
better
prepared. And during my first
solo interview too...
I'm so sorry!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
There's no need to worry. Or to
apologize. The
ink isn't coming out of
your pen, right?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Try warming it up with your hands a
little. Then
try writing on a tissue.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Tissue is more textured than regular
paper, so the
ink should have an easier
time coming out.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: It worked! You're a lifesaver!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute took care of three
separate
people's emergencies like they
were no big deal.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you think so? Truth be told, I
wasn't always
like this.
choice_data_list: 落ち着いていて、すごいな！
落ち着いていて、すごいね！
choice_data_list_en: You're so calm, that's amazing, huh!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I've always been more easygoing than
other
people, but that also means I tend
to make more
silly mistakes.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
But making these kinds of mistakes a lot
also
gives you experience in how to deal
with them.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I may seem put together now, but it's
the result of
lots of practice.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
In other words, there's nothing more
valuable
than experience.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It may sound obvious, but I suspect the
reason
she's able to learn from those
experiences is
specifically because she's
so determined to grow.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It may sound obvious, but I suspect the
reason
she's able to learn from those
experiences is
specifically because she's
so determined to grow.
choice_data_list: ナイスフォローだったな！
ナイスフォローだったね！
今日の取材も、いい経験になった？
choice_data_list_en: Was today's interview a good learning experience too?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
You think so? I was worried I might've
been
sticking my nose where it didn't
belong, so that's
good to hear.
choice_data_list: ナイスフォローだったな！
ナイスフォローだったね！
今日の取材も、いい経験になった？
choice_data_list_en: Was today's interview a good learning experience too?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Not in the slightest! Actually, I have
something
else I'd like to ask you!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Sure, dearie. I'm happy to do whatever I
can, so
ask away.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! Now, this only just came to
me, but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, letters for the
magazine's new
semiregular "Acute
Advice" column begin arriving.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I suppose it did! In fact, we're pretty
lucky we got
to experience such a
variety of problems today,
huh?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Sorry for the wait! I'm ready now!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Me too! And my signature racewear's
perfect! ☆

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Those two seem much less nervous
now.
What a relief.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Due in some part to Wonder Acute's
calm and
effortless help, the rest of the
interview finishes
without a hitch.
